title: Feature Flight: Sprint Map + Readiness Compact
summary: Compact one-page tracker to coordinate a mid-Q sprint 'feature flight' — combines milestone roadmap, KPI targets, minimal readiness checklist, canary criteria, and quick rollback/runbook bullets. Meant as the source of truth during the 3-week activation window.
milestones: Week 0: Freeze API surface + spec review (API owners: Jonas, Diego)
Week 1: Canary deploy to 1% traffic (internal + pilot customers)
Week 2: Expand to 10% with throttling controls and metric baselines
Week 3: Full ramp to GA (100%) with post-rollout quality sweep
kpi_targets: Error rate (5xx + business rejects): <= 0.4% during canary
Adoption: 25% of pilot customers convert to active usage within 2 weeks
Quality regression: BLEU/semantic-similarity drift <= 2% vs baseline eval
readiness_checklist: API contract signed off in spec doc + sample responses verified
Canary dataset prepared: 120 canonical prompts + 30 adversarial cases
Traffic routing policy configured in Smart Router (canary rules, backfill)
Observability: dashboards wired (latency by model, errors by route, token cost)
Traffic quotas / rate limits set for pilot orgs
SRE smoke tests: cold start, cache-warm, sustained qps 2x expected
Security: KMS key rotation verified and audit logs enabled for private customers
Customer comms draft ready (release notes + rollback expectations)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected latency spike after cache warm failure -> Mitigation: automated fallback to smaller quantized model + alert to SRE
Risk: Quality regression for long-context prompts -> Mitigation: holdback cohort, route long-context to slower TPU pool and run pairwise evals
Risk: Cost overshoot from runaway batching -> Mitigation: temporary rate caps + disable batch-merging heuristics via runtime flag
Risk: Pilot orgs hit data compliance flags -> Mitigation: enable private-deploy hook for those orgs or pause rollout for them
Risk: Telemetry gaps during deploy -> Mitigation: preflight synthetic probe with end-to-end tracing; block if missing traces
deployment_plan: Canary 1% -> observe 24h -> metrics OK -> 10% for 48h -> pre-schedule GA window
Automatic rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 400ms for 30m OR error rate > 1% for 15m
Manual holdpoints: pre-10% (product sign-off), pre-60% (GTM + CS sign-off)
Feature flags: enable/disable per-customer; switch to legacy model on failure
Configuration flags to test: batching window (10ms/50ms/100ms), kv_cache_ttl, quant_profile
monitoring_signals: Synthetic latency probes (every 1m) against canary endpoint
Token cost burn rate (1h rolling) + projection to daily spend
Model output quality monitor (semantic drift alert + top-10 regression queries)
Error breakdown by client, route, and model shard
Cache hit ratio and kv-store latencies
Trace sampling: 100% for canary traffic, 1% for GA traffic until stable
escalation_contacts: Customer Success lead for pilots: Elena Park
quick_actions: If p95 latency breach: switch canary to fallback endpoint and page SRE
If quality regression detected: pause rollout, run A/B on prior model and send eval bundle to ML lead
If cost burn > 30% projection: apply temporary rate limit and alert Finance ops
If pilot churn signal: open emergency CS thread and offer private deployment evaluation
notes_to_self: This 'compact' is intentionally minimal — prefer linking to canonical playbooks for long runbooks. Use this during standups as single source of truth; update the 'last_modified' and notify collaborators on meaningful changes.
postmortem_and_followups: Collect canary logs and top 50 failing prompts within 24h of any incident
Schedule a 90-minute debrief in product-ops and runtime teams within 72h of GA
Update rollout runbook with new thresholds if any auto-rollbacks triggered
